solution: Find the final space,then take the substring after it; if there is no space,the whole string is the only token. Under the stated format,the last token is the surname. Compound surnames would require different metadata or a different format.

marking_points.criterion: Locates last delimiter rather than first.
Correct handling of single token or justified format assumption.
